text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Debit Card Limits and Controls guide (updated February 2, 2026, for Harbor Visa debit cards on Retail checking accounts), the standard daily ATM cash withdrawal limit is $500 for most members. The separate daily point-of-sale purchase limit is $3,000, and cash back at a store counts toward the purchase limit rather than the ATM limit. Limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. Premier Checking cardholders may have higher limits based on their relationship with Harbor — you can see your own current limits in the app under Card Controls — Limits. Note that out-of-network ATM withdrawals carry a $2.50 fee per withdrawal, plus any ATM owner surcharge, per the 2026 Schedule of Fees and Charges: Retail Accounts.","cited_chunk_ids":["debit_card_limits::layout::B_structure::0001","debit_card_limits::layout::B_structure::0000","fee_schedule_2026::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The debit card limits guide states the $500 standard daily ATM withdrawal limit for retail debit cards."}
